questions: Did the documented IOS XE link-state body reach the native receiver and Splunk?
expected_findings: The interface reports down during FAILOVER and up during RECOVERY.

netspout_specific_spl: index=idx_network_ops sourcetype="netspout:cisco:iosxe:syslog" | stats count by netspout_phase
requirements: Use Cisco-supported IOS XE logging configuration and validate the deployed Splunk parsing contract.
known_gaps: Official current add-on sourcetype, extractions, and CIM mapping were not established.

limitations: Only the documented LINK-3-UPDOWN body is vendor-backed; outer framing and the sourcetype are NetSpout-defined.
format_validation: Strict declarative template validation preserves the documented message body.
runtime_validation: Phase 8C accepted summary: 4/4 generated records observed at the native receiver.
splunk_validation: Phase 8C accepted summary: 4/4 records found by authenticated source-scoped Splunk search.

questions: Did the IOS XE operations edge and IOS XR carrier edge transition on the same ordered clock?
expected_findings: Both independent source structures report the bounded link lifecycle under one run identifier.

production_portable_spl: index=<network_index> ("%LINK-3-UPDOWN" OR "%PKT_INFRA-LINK-3-UPDOWN") | stats values(_raw) by host
netspout_specific_spl: index=idx_network_ops (sourcetype="netspout:cisco:iosxe:syslog" OR sourcetype="netspout:cisco:iosxr:syslog") | stats count by sourcetype, netspout_phase
requirements: Normalize production entities and clocks before correlating independently collected domains.
known_gaps: No production cross-domain correlation, official sourcetype, or CIM mapping is claimed.

limitations: Correlation is driven by a shared lab clock; it does not prove production causality.
format_validation: Both vendor-documented message families pass their independent structural validators.
